emily: Quick brainstorm: need a compact battlecard + email test for our next benchmark webinar. Goal: show how serving-first beats generic cloud endpoints for latency-sensitive apps.

raj: I'll sketch the battlecard. Topline bullets: predictable p95 latency, per-route SLOs, private deployment option, transparent unit-costs. Keep each to one line for SDR quick-read.

sam: For email subjects, testing two flavors: 1) "Stop surprise inference costs" 2) "Ship reliable LLM features, not guesswork". Also try a benchmark hook subject: "See real-world unit-costs for convo apps".

claire: Demo plan: 15m talk + 15m live micro-bench. Live will show Dedicated routing then auto-fallback to Hosted; disclose dataset profile and seq lengths on slide. Ops-bot can we reserve a staging pod?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: reserved staging pod demo-canary-7 at 2025-06-03T09:40Z. Warmup scripts scheduled.

emily: Sales routing: leads who open benchmark PDF + have >$20k cloud AI spend => AE queue. SDRs get a 3-bullet TL;DR: "predictable latency", "cost visibility", "private option".

raj: Add quick rebut lines vs cloud APIs: they hide routing and fallbacks; they don't expose per-route cost attribution; limited private deployment. Keep language non-naming.

sam: Legal note: avoid absolute multipliers. Use "lower unit cost" or "improved cost predictability". Add methods appendix to benchmark PDF.

claire: Action items: raj drafts battlecard bullets by EOD; sam preps 3 subject lines & preview text; emily finalizes routing rule; i'll build demo slides and ops checklist. Review tomorrow 10am PT.

emily: Thanks team 680
